verdict.rationale: Server Pro is documented with a management API and per-user/device-group access control. However, nothing in the evidence shows that RustDesk can issue API tokens or credentials, or limit them to least-privilege scopes for an agent. Per-user access control governs who can reach which devices, which is an adjacent control rather than scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
